sobre.title: About
sobre.bio_1: Freelance video editor based in São Paulo with experience in digital content for YouTube, TikTok, and course platforms. Fluent in English, serving national and international clients with the same quality standard.
sobre.bio_2: My technical background (programming, automation, and AI tools) enables more efficient workflows and deeper understanding of tech-driven projects. But the core of the work is always editing: pacing, narrative, and visual communication that deliver a ready-to-publish video.
sobre.bio_3: I work with DaVinci Resolve as my primary tool, plus Adobe Premiere and After Effects for specific needs. Every project gets the attention it deserves, from the first cut to the final export.
sobre.exp_techbr_desc: Weekly tech review editing with jump cuts, motion graphics, and dynamic pacing.
sobre.exp_meyflower_desc: Narrative editing for anime content, structured for audience retention.
sobre.exp_dragrace_desc: Editing for Drag Race Brasil analysis videos, including color correction, audio treatment, and visual element integration.
sobre.exp_mamae_desc: E-commerce editing, Google Ads campaigns, and social media content.
sobre.como_trabalho_1: Every duration range has a clear deadline: up to 10 min in 1 business day, up to 20 min in 2 days, up to 60 min in 3 days. No vague timelines, no hidden delays.
sobre.como_trabalho_2: Custom scripts for subtitle extraction, media organization, and batch rendering. Less time on repetitive tasks means faster turnaround and fairer pricing.
sobre.como_trabalho_3: I deliver in multiple formats, with audio stems and effect layers with alpha channel. You get everything you need to publish, repurpose, or adapt across any platform.
sobre.como_trabalho_4: I have edited tech reviews, anime narrative content, e-commerce videos, and Google Ads. Each niche has its own pace, and I know which one to use.
sobre.cta_final: Like what you saw? Let's talk about your project.
